stories.title: Concern over maternity unit move prompts extra paramedic funding
stories.summary: Ambulance chief concerned by extra pressure on area that already has "poor ambulance performance"'.

stories.title: Police officers discovered Chloe Mitchell's remains in bins, court hears
stories.summary: The jury was previously told Brandon Rainey accepted he had killed Chloe but would rely on the partial defence of diminished responsibility.

stories.title: NI goods exports grew in 2025, official figures suggest
stories.summary: Trade figures are closely watched by politicians to assess the impact of Northern Ireland's post-Brexit deal.

stories.title: Crime falls to lowest recorded level but sexual offences up, figures show
stories.summary: New official data suggests that recorded crime in Northern Ireland has fallen to its lowest level since current records began in 1998.

stories.title: Police launch new plan to tackle 'parasite' of violence against women
stories.summary: The PSNI has said the new framework broadens its strategic focus to explicitly include children.

stories.title: Man in his 80s dies after house fire
stories.summary: A man in his 80s has died following a house fire in Omagh, County Tyrone, on Thursday afternoon.

stories.title: Police appeal after masked man tried to fire crossbow at PSNI station
stories.summary: Armed response units were deployed alongside local policing officers as a man was observed "brandishing what is believed to be a crossbow" in Belfast city centre.

stories.title: Hear ye, hear ye: Bewigged bricklayers and teachers turn to history acting
stories.summary: Almost 40,000 are expected to visit Armagh for the annual Georgian Festival which features several events including markets, concerts, walking tours and mock trials in the courthouse.

stories.title: Convicted rapist who abused wife was 'master manipulator'
stories.summary: Joanne Donald said her husband abused her "hundreds of times" over a nine-year period.

stories.title: Mark Allen named in UK Championship draw
stories.summary: Mark Selby is to start his defence of the UK Championship title against Matt Selt on Saturday in York.

stories.title: Students vote to retain university campus' historic name
stories.summary: Magee: The campus is named after Martha Magee, who bequeathed a sum of money in the mid-1800s to establish a theological college in Derry.

stories.title: State and police apologies must be backed by action, Finucane inquiry told
stories.summary: Finucane, 39, was shot by the Ulster Defence Association (UDA) at home in front of his wife and children in 1989.
